_regression.source: Hoshizora as it stands with its doss-house drawn SQUARE while the trunk road bends past it at 150 degrees - the shipped geometry, minus the waiver that excuses it. The GM's rule (2026-08-11): a roadside work stands on the way it serves and lies along it, because a doss-house exists to catch travelers off that road. Hoshizora is the one place in the pool where no seat allows it; this fixture keeps the check honest now that the live map no longer fails it.
